physicalSchema.coordinates: Original source pixels; EXIF orientation1, no rotation; manual 750x1000 inspection coordinates mechanically scaled to 1170x1560.

terrainAttributes.terrain: legacy vocabulary below, no per-image answers in repo

numberAttributes.number: integer when directly legible, otherwise null

physicalSchema.valueScorable: terrain/number literal directly legible in that source => true; occluded unreadable number => attributes.number=null and false. Robber is kind/location only: valueScorable=false, kindScorable=true.
physicalSchema.readability: readability.value=legible|unobservable-occluded; extent=visible|partially-occluded; clippedEdges=[]|[left]|[right]. A partially occluded but legible value remains scorable.
physicalSchema.clipping: Clipped physical objects retained using visible image-bounded envelope. Missing off-image contour is not completed.
physicalSchema.unknownLocation: All retained objects have a manually distinguishable envelope; covered disc outlines have wider explicit uncertainty.

matchingPolicy.method: Geometry-only reciprocal unique maximum IoU >= 0.25. A correspondence requires each box to be the unique maximum-IoU partner of the other; values and kind are not used to select or break matches. GT polygon is reduced to its axis-aligned envelope for box-to-box comparison.
matchingPolicy.predictionBoxOrder: box_1000=[ymin,xmin,ymax,xmax] converted once by width/height, no clipping/answer-driven adjustment
matchingPolicy.ties: Any tied maximum or non-reciprocal/visually indeterminate correspondence => AMBIGUOUS; values and kind are not used to break matches.
matchingPolicy.nullBoxes: unlocalized; no nearest matching by printed value
reportSeparately: continuous center error in original-image pixels
matchingPolicy.limitation: Approximate manual envelopes, foreground occlusion and neighboring hex bbox overlap; not precision masks. Center-only containment is not the primary matcher.
matchingPolicy.thresholdMeaning: 0.25 is a correspondence threshold, not a service pass mark.

annotationMethod.type: Manual approximate axis-aligned physical-object envelopes, not segmentation masks
annotationMethod.terrainUnit: physical hex envelope, including portions occluded by discs/pieces; adjacent hex envelopes overlap

uploadAuthority: Exact nine user attachments; explicit current user Gemini comparison request. Bounded comparison transmission authorized; no redistribution or training rights granted. No transmission performed by this task.
modelInputs: Source images only with supervisor-owned frozen D1 task. This index/contract/GT/overlay is evaluation metadata, not model context. No per-image answers/counts are to enter prompts.
limitations: Two number values obscured by robber are null
Same board/session sequence; not nine independent scenes or heldout-board accuracy
